description.value: A 73-site campground in the remote frontier town of Stewart, BC — the long paved spur off the Cassiar Highway is the commitment, rewarded by proximity to Bear Glacier and Salmon Glacier day trips; showers and device charging make it a proper resupply stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website returns a Wix 'domain not connected' error page, so no website content is available; all amenity and contact evidence comes from OSM tags only. OSM tags are treated as indicative but not authoritative per the rules, so I use them for shower=yes, toilets=yes, tents=yes, reservation=required, and power_supply=yes while flagging the website failure. Contact fields cannot be confirmed against the website since it is non-functional.
concerns: Website domain (raineycreekcampground.com) is not connected — Wix error page returned instead of site content; all amenity data relies solely on OSM tags and is unverified.
Contact information (phone, address) could not be confirmed against website.
pre_enrichment_exclude flag was set due to prefetch_failed_stub; website was reached but returned a Wix disconnected-domain page, not actual business content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The campground appears to be a real, established facility in Stewart, BC with a substantial 73-site capacity and detailed OSM tags; the non-functional website is a technical issue and not evidence the business is closed.

wow_evidence: proximity to Bear Glacier and Salmon Glacier day trips; showers and device charging make it a proper resupply stop
